import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
path=Path(".cache/phase1/pre-migration.dump")
with path.open("xb") as output:
    os.chmod(path,0o600)
    result=subprocess.run(["docker","compose","exec","-T","postgres","pg_dump","-U","research","-d","research","--format=custom"],stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,check=False)
if result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError("Pre-migration pg_dump failed")
print("Private pre-migration backup:",path,"bytes:",path.stat().st_size,"sha256:",hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
rows=[]
for service in ("postgres","redis","minio"):
    container=subprocess.check_output(["docker","compose","ps","-q",service],text=True).strip()
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","--format",'{"id":{{json .Id}},"started":{{json .State.StartedAt}},"mounts":{{json .Mounts}}}',container],text=True)
    rows.append({"service":service,"state":json.loads(raw)})
Path(".cache/phase1/data-services-before.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print("Data service identity/mount snapshot saved; no contents printed.")
